title: Greetings and what to say when introduced

unit.title: Greetings and what to say when introduced
unit.needIt: Knowing the right words makes people feel safe and respected around you. It helps you avoid awkward moments when meeting a new boss or a neighbor.
unit.why: Imagine meeting a new neighbor who looks nervous. If you use the right greeting, they relax and smile. If you use a weird phrase, they might feel confused or uneasy.
unit.outcome: Use the correct greeting to make others feel comfortable.
unit.reachesYou: You will use these rules when meeting a new coworker or a friend of a friend. You will also use them when you meet someone new at a party or a wedding.
unit.do: Practice saying 'How do you do?' clearly to a friend today to get used to the formal tone.

quiz.q: What is the correct formal greeting mentioned in the text?
quiz.why: The text states this is the correct formal greeting for people like ambassadors or formal acquaintances.
quiz.quote: As explained in the foregoing chapter, the correct formal greeting is: "How do you do?"

quiz.q: When should you say 'meet you at last'?
choices: When you have heard much of a person through common friends
quiz.why: The text says you can use this if you have heard much of the person through common friends.
quiz.quote: If you have, through friends in common, long heard of a certain lady, or gentleman, and you know that she, or he, also has heard much of you, you may say when you are introduced to meet you at last I

quiz.q: What should you avoid saying on any occasion?
quiz.why: The text explicitly tells the reader not to use this expression.
quiz.quote: Do not use the expression "pleased to meet you" then or on any occasion.

quiz.q: When is it okay to say 'Hello'?
quiz.why: The text says 'Hello' is for intimate friends who call each other by first names.
quiz.quote: Never used except between intimate friends who call each other by the first name.

quiz.q: What is the rule for saying 'Au revoir'?
quiz.why: The text says you should only say it if you have been talking French or are speaking to a French person.
quiz.quote: Never say "Au revoir" unless you have been talking French, or are speaking to a French person.

quiz.q: What should a gentleman do before shaking a lady's hand on the street?
quiz.why: The text specifies that a gentleman must remove his right glove first.
quiz.quote: A gentleman on the street never shakes hands with a lady without first removing his right glove.

partials: The correct formal greeting is How do you do?
Do not use pleased to meet you on any occasion.
Hello is for intimate friends only.
Never interlard conversation with foreign words.
A proper handshake should have strength and warmth.
crystal.key: Use specific, appropriate greetings to make others feel comfortable.

decoys.text: Say 'Hello' to everyone to be friendly.
decoys.why: The text says 'Hello' is only for intimate friends.

decoys.text: Always say 'Pleased to meet you' when meeting someone new.
decoys.why: The text says do not use that expression on any occasion.

crystal.aha: By choosing the right words for the right person, you create a comfortable social connection.
